name: @omadia/embedding-adapter-local
description: Keyless in-process embedding adapter for omadia. Runs a quantized multilingual sentence-transformer on the CPU through onnxruntime and provides the 'embeddingClient@1' capability, as the alternative to the Ollama adapter (needs a local server) and the OpenAI-compatible adapter (needs an API key). Model weights are fetched once, never bundled.
